title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
description:
Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their
logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and
in our hands it is mostly an engineering one.

We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway 
management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001. 

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

The work in front of us 

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

- Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on
technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget.
- User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies,
partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app.
- API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.
- Payments and billing. 
- ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging,
observability and alerting, consent and retention.
- The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScript, Docker Swarm on
Hetzner, Cloudflare at the edge, Tailscale for all engineer and CI access.
- Third-party integrations — usually the seam between two systems that were
never designed to meet.

Nobody arrives fluent in all of that, and we are not expecting it. We want
someone strong across a good part of it, comfortable being new to the rest, and
used to working things out — with a team and with agents, rather than alone.

Also in daily use: Postgres and PostGIS, Valkey, ClickHouse; Vite, Tailwind and
Radix; Jest and Playwright; GitHub Actions; HAProxy. Most of what we write is
TypeScript, strict — though our core API is Java and Spring, and the identity
layer has Java in it too, so how far you go into that side is up to you.

How we work 

LLM-native, in the codebases you would work in. They are built around
agent-assisted development rather than merely tolerant of it — the conventions,
the tooling and the review gates all assume it. Agents do most of the
implementation and much of the review; humans design, verify and approve. What
we are really hiring for is judgement over output you did not write by hand :
knowing what to specify, what to check, and what to throw away. The bar did not
move when the tooling did.

Shape Up, and you own what you take. Roughly three weeks of building, then a
week of cooldown, with bets chosen at a betting table. We are small enough that
an area becomes yours quickly — you make the calls inside it and you answer for
how it turns out. We hand out problems, not the steps that solve them.

Remote first, with most of the team in Europe and everyone together in person at
least twice a year. Significant technical decisions get written down, and a
green build is never on its own enough to merge.

Requirements 

You'll thrive here if you have…

- Senior full-stack experience — you have owned features from the browser to
the machine they run on.
- A track record of taking something and running with it — a domain, a
migration, a subsystem you took on, decided and stayed accountable for.
- Taste. You can tell a good design from a merely plausible one, and you
will reject work that functions but is not right — your own, and an agent's.
- React beyond the client — server rendering, static generation, data
loading and hydration; you know what runs where and why it matters.
- TypeScript at strict — typed boundaries, and an instinct for when types
are carrying real weight.
- Infrastructure as code — Pulumi ideally; Terraform if you are ready to
pick up Pulumi.
- Containers and Linux in production — not writing a Dockerfile, but
debugging a service on a machine you have to SSH into.
- Postgres beyond queries — backup and restore, migrations, what a schema
change does under load.
- Wholehearted LLM-assisted development — you use coding agents daily, have
opinions about steering them, and review their output as critically as a
colleague's.
- Integration instincts — third-party APIs, webhooks, OAuth/OIDC, and
patience for other people's undocumented edge cases.
- A working day that overlaps ours : based within CET ±3.
- Fluent in English, our working language.

Nice to have 

- Identity and API gateways in depth — Keycloak, OIDC, SAML brokering, APISIX.
- Compliance from the inside — an ISO 27001 certification lived through, or GDPR
beyond a cookie banner.
- Payment systems, billing models, or PSP integrations.
- Observability and alerting — Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent.
- Experience in the maritime, logistics or freight industry.
- Familiarity with emissions accounting frameworks (GHG Protocol, GLEC, EU
ETS..).
Benefits 

As part of our team, you will:

- 🌱 Have a chance to re-shape the future of climate in the logistics.
- 👩‍💻 Be empowered to deliver your best work remotely, and get a stipend to set
you up.
- 🏄‍♂️ Have a flat hierarchy, where you will have direct access to the founders
and won't be tied up in politics.
- 🎓 Have a high degree of learning and ownership in a dynamic environment.
- 🏝 Take part in our team-building events.

title: Senior Full Stack
description:
Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia

URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ 

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.

You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.

The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. 

You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. 

The Role 

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.

You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.

Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.

Your main responsibilities will be:

Ownership and delivery 

- 
Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.

- 
Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.

- 
Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.

Craft and quality across the stack 

- 
Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.

- 
Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.

- 
Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.

- 
Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.

Working with product and design 

- 
Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.

- 
Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.

- 
Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.

Raising the bar 

- 
Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.

- 
Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.

- 
Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.

AI as core leverage 

- 
Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.

About You 

You will thrive in this role if you:

- 
Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.

- 
Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.

- 
Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.

- 
Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. 

- 
Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.

- 
Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.

- 
Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.

- 
Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.

- 
Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.

- 
Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.

- 
Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.

- 
Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.

- 
Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.

- 
Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.

- 
Nice to have: 

- 
Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.

- 
Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.

- 
Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.

This Role Is NOT 

- 
A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.

- 
A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.

- 
A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.

- 
A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA
team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your
tests, or own your performance regressions.

- 
A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.

- 
A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.

The Team 

We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results.

What's Happening at Toggl 

Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.

Benefits 

- 
Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results

- 
24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays

- 
Unlimited sick leave

- 
In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)

- 
4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)

- 
Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years

- 
€2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure

- 
€3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home

- 
€4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences

- 
€2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health

- 
Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair)

About PerfectServe

PerfectServe is committed to compliance with its obligations under all applicable state and federal laws prohibiting employment discrimination. title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote in Deutschland)
description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns 
ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle 
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

- Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

- Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

- Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

- Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.

- LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist.

Unser minimalistischer Tech Stack 
Alles ist TypeScript. Vom Datenbankschema bis ins Frontend.
Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions)
Frontend: , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
Technologien, die dir begegnen werden: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component

Gehalt

5000 – 6000 Euro brutto, mit Raum für Wachstum und Beförderungen in den kommenden Monaten und Jahren

Benefits

- 100 % remote

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten

- So viele KI-Tokens, wie du brauchst

- Wir sind eigenfinanziert und profitabel (und verbrennen kein VC-Geld, um zu überleben)

- Kleines Team, echte Verantwortung — was du baust, geht auch wirklich live

- Schnelle Entscheidungen, keine sinnlosen Meetings und keine Freigabeschleifen, durch die du dich kämpfen musst

Unsere Werte

- Dinge fertig machen, jeder Tag zählt

- Transparenz und Ehrlichkeit, gerade wenn es unangenehm wird

- Nach Großem streben – dich und andere ständig fordern

Wenn du genauer sehen willst, was wir bauen: Schau auf unserem YouTube-Kanal vorbei — kleiner Hinweis, der ist auf Deutsch.

Requirements

Du bist

- fließend in Englisch und Deutsch

- ein erfahrener Entwickler mit mehr als 2 Jahren Erfahrung im Bauen von Agenten für den Produktivbetrieb

- AI-native. Du hast agentische Features ausgeliefert, auf die sich echte Nutzer verlassen, und du hast eine Meinung zu Retrieval, Evals, Tool-Design und dazu, wo die heutigen Spitzenmodelle an ihre Grenzen kommen.

- in erster Linie Builder. Du bringst lieber heute eine grobe v1 raus, als drei Wochen lang die perfekte zu planen.

- auf dem neuesten Stand bei neuen KI-Modellen und der Forschung

- jemand, der fast seinen gesamten Code mit KI schreibt

- es gewohnt, autonom zu arbeiten und volle Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben zu übernehmen

- unter Leistungsdruck sogar noch besser

- schnell darin, Neues zu lernen, und siehst dich als Generalist, nicht als Spezialist

Dein Techstack :

Ist nicht wichtig, da bei uns KI deinen Code schreiben wird.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. 

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. 

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. 

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. 

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Full Stack Engineer 

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take primary ownership of our frontend experience while being capable of making the backend changes needed to unblock yourself and your team. You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance products end-to-end, from pixel to API.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you'll do in this role

- Design, develop, and maintain frontend components in Angular (and Lit HTML where applicable), ensuring optimal performance, responsiveness, and usability.

- Own the integration layer between frontend and backend: consume and contribute to OpenAPI-defined APIs, handle data contracts, and wire up microservices cleanly.

- Make targeted backend changes, new endpoints, tweaks to existing services, minor data model updates, so you can ship features without always depending on a dedicated backend engineer.

- Contribute to architectural discussions across the full stack, from UI component structure to API design and data access patterns.

- Participate actively in code reviews, providing feedback on both frontend and backend code quality, adherence to standards, and performance.

- Mentor and support junior engineers across the stack.

- Stay current with evolving frontend and full-stack best practices.

What you bring to the table

- 3+ years of experience in frontend or full stack engineering.

- Strong proficiency in Angular and experience with component-based frameworks such as Lit HTML.

- Solid understanding of responsive design, UX/UI principles, and a keen eye for design detail.

- Proven experience integrating with APIs and microservices, you understand HTTP, REST conventions, auth flows, and error handling deeply.

- Working proficiency in Python, enough to navigate a FastAPI codebase, add or adjust endpoints, and write Pydantic models and SQLAlchemy queries.

- Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) at the query and schema level.

- Experience with containerised workflows using Docker.

- Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working independently and collaboratively.

- Strong English communication skills and ability to work across disciplines.

- Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow.

- Familiarity with LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and an understanding of the UX patterns specific to AI-powered features.

What success in the first 6 months looks like

- You've built trust with Backend, DevOps, and Product peers and taken clear ownership of 2–3 frontend domains, including their design system consistency and API integration contracts.

- You've delivered frontend features end-to-end, from UX design discussion through Angular implementation, API wiring, tests, and documentation, without needing hand-holding at either layer.

- You've unblocked yourself (and others) by making safe, well-reviewed backend changes: adding an endpoint, adjusting a response model, or optimising a query, rather than waiting in a queue.

- You've raised frontend quality: responsive across devices, accessible, consistent with our design system, and validated against real API contracts rather than mocks.

- You've contributed to meaningful observability on the frontend, error tracking, performance budgets, and linked them to backend SLIs where relevant.

- You've shared knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and mentoring, so the team's frontend capability grows with you.

Current tech stack

We're fully cloud-native on AWS, with a lean, API-first product development approach.

Frontend: Angular · Lit HTML · Headless Wagtail · WordPress

Backend: Python · FastAPI · Pydantic · SQLAlchemy · MySQL · Neo4j

Platform: AWS · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker · GitHub Actions · ruff · UV · pre-commit · Renovate

Our platform runs on Kubernetes-managed services and Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue expanding capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and modern data access patterns.

What we offer: 

- Impactful work that helps patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. 

- International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organizational structure that encourages creativity and accountability. 

- Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and an Employee Stock Option Plan. 

- Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company. 

- Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions. 

- Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows. 

- Hybrid working model. 

- Policies to support working parents. 

- Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office. 

- Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp 

- Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual ‘myTomorrowland’ company-wide celebration! 

Equal opportunities 

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

title: Team Lead Manager - Product Engineer
description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here .

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for highly technical engineers who want to lead and manage one of our engineering teams. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans, and we’re now growing from 11 to more than 14 engineering teams in the coming months. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple.

As a Team Lead Manager, you’ll lead a small team of engineers. You’ll set its technical direction, line-manage and grow the people in it, and stay hands-on in the code. This is not a hands-off management role: our teams are small, and you’ll be one of the strongest engineers on yours. You’ll partner closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer to decide what to build, and you’ll be accountable for how well it’s built and how fast it ships.

If you’re a strong Tech Lead who hasn’t managed people yet, we’d still love to hear from you. You can start as a Team Lead, with management handled by an Engineering Manager, and grow into the full role with our support.

What Can You Expect As a Team Lead Manager?

- Lead and Manage a Small Team. Line-manage the engineers on your team, run 1:1s, give feedback, and help them take on bigger problems.

- Stay Deeply Technical. You’ll still build. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time writing code, reviewing PRs, and unblocking the hardest technical problems.

- AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude, Code, and agentic workflows every day, and our product is built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows. You’ll set the bar for how your team uses them.

- Customers at the Center. Talk directly with customers to understand their problems, and make sure your team builds things that create real value for them.

- Own Technical Direction. Make the architecture and design calls for your team’s problem space, and own the trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.

- Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript across the stack, React, Postgres, and AWS serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. Datadog, Meticulous, and Incident.io round it out.

- Shape the Roadmap. Work with your PM and Designer on prioritisation, scoping, and sequencing so the team ships what matters most.

- Build the Team. Interview, hire, and onboard new engineers as we double in size.

About You

- You’re a highly technical full-stack engineer. You’ve designed and shipped web apps end to end in TypeScript, ideally on AWS serverless, and you’re still one of the strongest engineers in the room.

- You’ve led engineers. You’ve been a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or TLM, owning delivery and technical direction for a team.

- You want to manage people, or grow into it. Ideally, you’ve line-managed engineers already. If not, you’re keen to learn.

- You still love to build. Leading hasn’t pulled you away from the code, and you want a role where you keep shipping.

- You raise the bar. You know what well-architected, reliable software looks like, and you help others get there through reviews, pairing, and clear feedback.

- You’re motivated by customer impact. You care about outcomes for customers, not just output, and you make good calls on what to build and what to cut.

- You’re a strong partner. You work well with product and design, push back when it matters, and bring people with you.

- You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You can take an unclear problem, shape it, and get a team moving on it.

Nice-to-Haves

- You’ve led a team through fast growth, ideally at a scale-up where the team and product changed quickly.

- You’ve built B2B or enterprise SaaS, with complex workflows and demanding customers.

- You’ve performed exceptionally at something else, be it academics, sport, or work.

Interview Process

Before applying, we strongly encourage you to spend a few minutes in our R&D Candidate Hub. It covers our engineering culture, ways of working, interview process, tech environment, and what it’s like to build at Omnea.

R&D Candidate Hub : https://omnea.notion.site/R-D-Candidate-Hub-2f688cce658780f1b942c81cd3a032d4 

Note: our pair programming stage is in TypeScript OR Python and you’ll be assessed as if it’s your primary language. This is a full-stack, hands-on leadership role, so if you’re exclusively frontend, backend, or platform-focused, or no longer writing code, it likely isn’t the right fit.

The process generally includes:

- Initial screening call with our Talent team (30 mins, remote)

- AI Product Eng Challenge , language-agnostic (1 hour, remote)

- Onsite interviews at our Victoria office (~3 hours)

- Engineering Culture interview with an Engineering Manager or Team Lead (45 mins)

- System Design interview with a Senior Engineer (60 mins)

- Engineering Leadership interview with our CTO (45 mins)

- Office tour (15 mins)

We’re proud to support visa sponsorship for candidates who need it.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note: 

- We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here . 

- We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here 

- We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive . You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here !

- We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
description:
About Finom 

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role 

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day. 

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes. 

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership. 

How We Build 

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.

What You'll Do 

What You'll Do 

- 
Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation. 

- 
Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle. 

- 
Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details. 

- 
Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 

- 
Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech. 

- 
Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team. 

Who You Are 

Who You Are 

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three. 

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue. 

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build. 

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team. 

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform. 

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague. 

Your Experience Includes 

- 
5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift. 

- 
Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns. 

- 
Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better. 

- 
Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI. 

- 
Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools. 

- 
Ability to write unit and UI tests. 

- 
Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD. 

- 
Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included. 

- 
A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code. 

Nice to Have 

Nice to Have 

- 
Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment. 

- 
Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain). 

- 
Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS. 

- 
Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar. 

- 
Published apps on the App Store you're proud of. 

- 
An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share. 

- 
Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI development practices. 

- 
Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively. 

- 
Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows. 

Recruitment Flow 

- Recruiter Interview

- First Technical Interview

- Coding / AI assisted coding interview

- Mobile System Design Interview

- Team Fit Interview (peer interview)

- Offer

What You Will Get In Return 

Make a genuine impact on the product 

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product. 

Work in the EU 

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe. 

Become a stock options holder 

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders. 

Receive unwavering support and care 

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling. 

Work & Swim program 

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views. 

Equal Opportunity Statement 

At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Singulier is a strategy, transaction advisory and AI transformation consulting firm supporting private equity funds, portfolio companies and established businesses on their most critical strategic and operational challenges. We combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to help our clients make better decisions, accelerate value creation and deliver tangible business impact. 

Singulier x OMMAX are joining forces to build a leading European AI management consulting platform, combining deep strategic expertise with technology, data and AI capabilities. Together, we support clients across the full value creation journey, from strategy and due diligence through transformation and execution. 

We operate in a partner-led, entrepreneurial environment where everyone is expected to think critically, take ownership early and work directly with senior stakeholders. 

What you will do 

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build and deploy AI, data and software solutions directly with our clients. 

You are an engineer first: you write production code and take technical ownership of complex projects from discovery through production and handover.

You will work with client teams, alongside Singulier engineers, Product Owners, delivery managers and advisory colleagues:

- Build and ship: write, review and debug production code. Build applications, integrations, data pipelines and AI workflows or agents that connect models to client data, tools and processes. 
- Design the solution: translate business priorities into architecture, technical scope and estimates, and make explicit trade-offs between quality, cost and speed. 
- Run it in production: put in place testing, AI evaluations, access controls, monitoring and deployment suited to the client's systems and constraints. 
- Drive adoption: understand workflows, test assumptions with users and explain technical choices to engineers and executives. Agree success measures upfront, track adoption and business impact, and hand over with documentation and training. 
- Lead technically: guide other engineers through design and debugging, coordinate technical dependencies, and turn project work into reusable components and patterns. This is a senior individual contributor role. 

Beyond client work, you will help build the firm: scoping and estimating new projects, interviewing engineering candidates, and contributing to internal AI initiatives and experimentation. 

Work environment : engineering culture and stack 

We are building a small, highly skilled delivery team that shares engineering patterns and goes deep on a focused stack. Our aim is to make AI and technology transformation practical for mid-sized companies, within their budgets, teams and operating realities. Reusing proven foundations across projects lets us deliver faster, with consistent quality and a clear path to business value. 

The stack below is our default, not a constraint: we adapt to client environments and adopt new tools when the benefit is clear. 

- Ways of working: Git, pull requests, code reviews, automated tests and CI/CD. Monitoring, evaluations and tracing ship with every AI application. 
- Languages and frameworks: Python, SQL and TypeScript; Polars, FastAPI, Pydantic and Pydantic AI. 
- Data: PostgreSQL, DuckDB, LanceDB and Parquet, with attention to data quality, modelling and the simplest design that meets performance and scale needs. 
- Infrastructure: infrastructure as code, Docker, and disciplined configuration, secrets and environment management. Databricks and Google Cloud, including BigQuery, when the workload calls for them. 

You do not need to have used every tool listed. We care about what you have shipped, how you collaborate and what production has taught you. 

Requirements 

You will likely bring: 

- 6+ years as a hands-on engineer in software, data or applied AI, including technical ownership of complex production deployments. 
- Strong Python, fluent SQL and enough TypeScript to contribute across the stack. 
- Experience shipping LLM-based solutions to production: evaluating their behaviour and designing around their limitations in real workflows. 
- Solid grounding in APIs, data modelling, storage and pipelines, and practical experience with cloud services and infrastructure as code. 
- Strong engineering habits around code review, automated testing and CI/CD, and the judgement to make architecture decisions and guide other engineers. 
- Comfort in unfamiliar client environments: clarifying ambiguous requirements and discussing scope, commitments and trade-offs with senior stakeholders. 
- Commercial sense: you care whether what you build moves operational and financial results. 
- Fluency in French and English. 

Experience in consulting or client-facing delivery, business process automation, or transformation in mid-sized or PE-backed companies would be valuable. A degree in engineering, Computer Science or a related field is welcome, as is equivalent practical experience. 

Why join us 

- Real impact, in production: what you build changes how our clients operate, and you see the results.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Backend (USA Only - 100% Remote)
description:
About Us

Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale.

We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales.

Our Stack

Our backend tech stack consists primarily of Python Flask web apps with our TaskTiger scheduler handling many of the backend asynchronous task processing chores. Our data stores include MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Redis. The underlying infrastructure runs on AWS using a combination of managed services like EKS, MSK, RDS and ElastiCache and non-managed services running on EC2 instances. We have CI/CD pipelines that build Docker images, run automated tests and deploy to Kubernetes clusters. We also use these images in our local development environment allowing coding locally against all of our services. We have a well-documented public API that is consumed by our front-end JavaScript app as well as numerous integrations. Our infrastructure is heavily automated using Terraform, Ansible and other AWS tools. 

We love open sourcing our code and ideas on our GitHub and on The Making of Close , our behind-the-scenes Product & Engineering blog. Check out our open source projects like SocketShark , TaskTiger , LimitLion and ciso8601 .

AI is both how we build and what we ship, and that's reshaped what engineering looks like. This is a transformation we’re embracing and find deeply exciting. 

Our Teams

When you apply, you’ll have an opportunity to highlight the team that appeals to you the most. We’ll do our best to honor this preference, but we'll also be evaluating skillset fit and the needs of the business.

One thing to know up front: we do move people between teams as the work shifts. Most engineers here end up on more than one team over their time at Close - this team is where you’ll start, but over time you’ll likely have the opportunity to work on many different projects.

The work splits roughly like this. Pick the team that excites you most:

- 
Agents. Build Close’s agentic platform and customer-facing AI experiences. Voice Agents, Custom Agents, and Ask Chloe are already in flight. You’d work on the shared intelligence and orchestration layer that powers AI-driven processes across the product. That includes the ecosystem around our APIs and MCP surface, which enables external agents like Claude and ChatGPT to operate Close. This team is pushing deeper into applied AI, retrieval, and agent infrastructure more than ever before.

- 
Communications. Own the voice, SMS, and email infrastructure powering Close — Twilio, WebRTC, WebSockets, AssemblyAI, ElevenLabs, and more. You’ll help build our voice, messaging, and conversational AI agents while scaling real-time AI across calls, email, and calendar sync infrastructure.

- 
CRM. Build the structured context layer that humans and agents both depend on. We're rebuilding the data model so it flexes with real businesses, making the CRM agent-ready (retrieval, traversal, action coverage through MCP and our public API), and shipping the next generation of AI-native CRM features (AI Enrich, Autofill, AI Search). Operating on billions of Mongo documents with Elasticsearch underneath.

- 
Growth. Run the experiments and own the billing infrastructure that turn trials into paid customers. Stripe metered billing, AI credit top-ups, the activation and conversion funnel, and the team's biggest bet right now: agentic onboarding (an agent that walks new customers through setup, configuration, and first comms). Hypothesis-driven, metric-first.

You Are

- 
A seasoned engineer. Python is our backbone, but perhaps you’ve worked across Go, Rust, or TypeScript. You pick the right tool for the problem rather than retreating to what you know. You’ve seen a variety of problems, can collaborate and self-direct.

- 
Building AI. You've shipped LLM-backed features for real users and have a POV on where they're trustworthy, where they fall over, and how to get them production-ready when customers bet revenue on the output. We use Pydantic, Temporal, LangFuse, and other modern AI infrastructure tooling to power our agent platform.

- 
Working with AI in your day-to-day. You use AI tools in your own workflow to ship faster, write tighter code, and reason about unfamiliar parts of the codebase. We fund the use of AI tools (Claude Code, Codex and other best-in-class developer tools) and treat learning and experimentation as part of the work.

- 
A builder first. You’d rather get the first iteration of a feature in front of fifty customers than spend three weeks fretting over a perfect PR. You ship.

- 
Opinionated about API design for modern software. You've shipped internet-facing APIs and you think about who's on the other end - apps, agents, humans poking around in docs - and what each of them needs.

- 
Battle-tested. You've debugged incidents where latency budgets didn't hold, owned a system everyone else relied on, or carried a pager for something with real customer impact.

Benefits

- 
Compensation: Competitive pay plus an organization-wide goal-based bonus

- 
Paid Time Off: ~5 weeks of PTO to start. Plus a 1-week all-company Winter Holiday Break and paid US holidays. You'll earn 2 extra days for every year you're with Close.

- 
80% Work Option: Work with your manager to choose between a standard 5-day week or a 4-day week at 80% pay

- 
Parental Leave: Paid leave for primary and secondary caregivers

- 
Sabbatical: A 1-month paid sabbatical every 5 years with the team

- 
Healthcare (US residents): Two medical plans with Close covering 99% of your premium, plus Dental, Vision, HSA, FSA, and company-paid Long-Term Disability

- 
401k (US residents): We match your contributions up to 6%, vested immediately

Our Values

Build a house you want to live in - Examine long-term thinking and action

No BS - Practice transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard

Invest in each other - Build successful relationships with your coworkers and customers

Discipline equals freedom - Keep your word to yourself and others

Strive for greatness - Constantly challenge yourself and others

Learn More

Listen to our CEO and Founder, Steli Efti, tell the story of Close’s journey in the $0-30m Blueprint . 

Watch our culture video from our 2023 team retreat in Milan. Every year our entire team gathers in person to build connection, foster cross-functional collaboration, and have fun. In 2027, we're headed to Dusseldorf, Germany! 

Explore our product. Check out a demo !

Our Hiring Process

We ask a few role-specific questions as part of our application process. These questions are designed to help us learn more about you from the start, so please answer each one thoughtfully. We see this as an opportunity to get to know you beyond your resume.

We use AI tools daily at Close and expect candidates to do the same. In evaluating your application, we aim to get a sense for you - the way you think, how you communicate, the work you've done. Applications that read as fully AI-generated will not be considered.

Regardless of fit, you can expect to hear back from our team with an update on the status of your candidacy.

If you progress to the interview process, you'll receive a full outline of the role-specific steps in your first touchpoint with us. We do our best to make the hiring process clear and human.

title: Senior Engineer - DevOps
description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What’s the position?

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing Product & Technology organization at Hard Rock Digital . In this role, you will help build and scale the internal developer platform that powers our gaming and entertainment products—making it faster and safer for every engineering team to ship.

This is a platform engineering–focused role: rather than only maintaining infrastructure, you’ll design and build self-service workflows, golden paths, and developer tooling on top of Backstage, our internal developer platform (IDP) of choice. You’ll partner with product engineering teams to understand their pain points and turn them into paved-road, self-serve capabilities—provisioning, CI/CD, environments, observability, and more—so teams can move independently without sacrificing security or compliance.

You’ll also model what it means to operate at the pace of AI-enabled engineering: fluently using AI coding assistants, agentic tooling, and LLM-powered workflows to design platform capabilities faster, automate toil, and raise the bar for the entire team.

What will you do?

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineering, you will:

- Design, build, and operate our internal developer platform on Backstage, including software catalog, templates, plugins, and scorecards that give engineers a consistent, self-service experience across the stack.

- Create golden-path templates and self-service workflows (Backstage Software Templates, Terraform/Terragrunt modules, CI/CD scaffolding) that let product teams provision infrastructure, services, and environments without filing a ticket.

- Architect and implement scalable AWS and hybrid-cloud infrastructure using Terraform/Terragrunt and related Infrastructure as Code tools, exposed to engineering teams through self-service platform interfaces.

- Design, build, and optimize highly available containerized environments leveraging EKS, Kubernetes, and Docker, and surface them as consumable platform primitives.

- Lead the automation strategy for CI/CD pipelines (TeamCity, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, and similar), building reusable, self-service pipeline patterns that scale across teams.

- Champion security and compliance by design, embedding guardrails, identity/access controls, and policy-as-code directly into the self-service platform so "paved road" is always the secure road.

- Partner with product engineering, SRE, QA, security, and operations teams to identify friction points and convert them into platform capabilities that improve developer experience and velocity.

- Define and track developer experience (DevEx) and platform adoption metrics (lead time, self-service usage, ticket deflection) to demonstrate platform impact.

- Leverage AI tools fluently as a core part of your daily workflow—using AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex), agentic automation, and LLM-powered tooling to accelerate platform delivery, generate and review Backstage plugins/templates, and help the broader team adopt AI-enabled ways of working.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

We’re seeking an experienced engineer who is genuinely energized by platform engineering—building tools and paved roads that make other engineers more productive, not just running infrastructure. You should be comfortable owning architecture and implementation decisions for internal developer platforms while helping elevate the DevOps discipline across the organization. Critically, you’re someone who has embraced AI tooling not as a novelty but as a genuine force multiplier—and who can help others do the same.

The ideal candidate will have:

- 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or similar roles, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead capacity.

- Hands-on experience building or operating an internal developer platform (IDP)—Backstage strongly preferred—including catalog design, software templates, and custom plugin development.

- A track record of designing self-service workflows and golden paths that reduce toil and ticket volume for product engineering teams.

- Expert-level knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native architectures (multi-account setups, VPC design, IAM policies, networking).

- Strong experience with Kubernetes (EKS preferred), Docker, and Helm for container orchestration and management.

- Advanced Infrastructure as Code (IaC) expertise using Terraform/Terragrunt, with deep understanding of modular design and reusability suitable for self-service consumption.

- Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, TypeScript/ (useful for Backstage plugin development), or other relevant languages.

- Experience leading CI/CD initiatives and designing scalable, self-service delivery pipelines with GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, or comparable tools.

- Strong understanding of observability practices and performance monitoring frameworks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog, etc.), ideally surfaced through platform tooling.

- Comprehensive knowledge of networking, security hardening, and compliance in regulated industries, and experience embedding these as automated guardrails.

- Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction in cross-functional teams.

- AWS Professional Certification (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, or SysOps Administrator) strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated fluency with AI development tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar), including practical experience integrating AI assistants into infrastructure workflows, platform tooling, code review, incident response, or documentation. The ability to operate at AI-enabled development velocity is a core expectation of this role, not a nice-to-have.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

- Competitive pay and benefits

- Flexible vacation allowance

- A hybrid / remote working environment

- Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:
Headquarters: Australia 

URL: https://www.askablelabs.com/ 

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works 

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

- Regular use of an AI coding tool

- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

- At least 10 hours a week, starting now

- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have 

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms 

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/askable-software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-contract

title: Generative Media Engineer, AI Social - CANADA
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity 

AI Social is one of the most ambitious products we've ever shipped. An AI agent that produces on-brand Instagram carousels and reels for every Luxury Presence customer, from raw input data to finished media. It isn't LLMs writing code. It's LLMs designing, choosing the photo, voicing the script, picking the cuts, and composing the final frame.

As the Generative Media Engineer on AI Social , you own the render pipeline, the prompts and agent loops that drive it, and the visual quality of what ships. Product and content strategy partners set the direction; engineering and design peers ship alongside you. This is an unusual role at the intersection of code, design, AI, and social media. You don't fit the normal engineering mold, that's the point.

Skills and experience 

- Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js. You're comfortable shipping production code and you're ready to grow into our stack.

- Hands-on experience with LLM-driven systems. Prompts, structured outputs, tool-calling, agent loops, evals.

- At least one shipped piece of generative media in image, video, voice, or music that someone other than you has seen and used.

- A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates both technical depth and design sensibility.

- Bonus: a personal creator practice somewhere. A feed, a portfolio, a side project, a YouTube channel, an Are.na . Public, ongoing, under your own name. You understand the medium because you've lived in it.

- Formal or self-taught grounding in design, visual art, film, or motion.

- Comfort moving between exploratory PoC work and shipped-to-customers polish, with judgment about which mode is appropriate when.

Technical fluency with AI tools 

- You're already using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted development tools in your daily workflow. We're a Claude Code shop and we expect you to be fluent.

- Familiarity with MCPs and how tools like Figma, Notion, and Linear connect into AI-assisted workflows. You understand how these tools and integrations fit together and can help the team get more out of them.

- Beyond fluency, you're a dabbler and experimenter. You try new prompts, push their limits, and share what you learn. You have opinions about where the medium is headed.

Mindset 

- You're a tinkerer. You don't just build what's asked; you spot leverage points and build what's needed.

- You care about systems more than features. You'd rather build a template family that ships ten posts well than ten bespoke posts that age out by next week.

- You build on shared systems. Constraints feel like leverage, not obstacles.

- You have strong convictions about quality, but you ship. You know the difference between polish that matters and perfection that stalls.

- You partner well with non-engineers. You'll collaborate across product, design, and content strategy. Patience and clarity with people outside engineering is non-negotiable.

- You operate with high ownership and low ego. You take direction from product and strategy partners on what to build, and you raise the bar on everything you ship.

What You Won't Be Doing 

To be clear about what this role is not:

- You won't own platform architecture or distributed systems work. You'll partner with engineering teams that do, while you stay focused on the AI Social pipeline itself.

- You won't own the social strategy. You'll have a real voice in shaping it, but the call sits with our product and content strategy partners.

- You won't be managing people on day one. This is a hands-on IC role with the expectation that you lead through craft and influence.

Tech stack 

- Platform: Node, TypeScript, React, Postgres, AWS, Temporal

- LLMs and agents: the major model SDKs, with tool-calling, structured outputs, and multi-step agent loops

- Media pipeline: image and video generation (Veo for video), voice and music synthesis (ElevenLabs), composite (Shotstack), and headless browser rendering

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate 

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role 

We’re looking for an exceptional Design Engineer (Site) to own https://infisical.com and show the world what we're about.

In this role, you'll work with engineering, design, and marketing to be the go-to person for everything having to do with building and maintaining the design and infrastructure of the landing page; we want this surface to be iconic and performant to drive organic traffic and user adoption.

This role is for someone who has a frontend-leaning full stack engineering background, who obsesses over crafting pixel-perfect experiences, cares about building sound underlying infrastructure, and is motivated to help build out our growth engine.

You'll work closely with our co-founder, engineering, design, and marketing to:

- 
Design and ship pixel-perfect, reusable components and complex designs.

- 
Build and maintain core website pages (home, product, blogs, learning/resource hub etc.), microsites, frontend architecture, code quality, CMS integration and experience.

- 
Implement SEO best practices, run A/B tests, and optimize conversion funnels.

- 
Integrate analytics, attribution, and marketing tooling - Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, HubSpot, etc.

Requirements 

- 
Deep mastery of JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and frameworks like React/Next.js.

- 
Experience building high-quality frontend systems and components with strong attention to performance, accessibility, and maintainability.

- 
Experience with web design and design systems.

- 
Exceptional attention to detail and eagerness to learn.

- 
Bias toward action: able to make decisions, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

- 
Based in the Americas (SF preferred) or able to work EST hours.

Nice to have 

- 
Technical SEO fundamentals.

- 
Experience with CMS platforms (e.g. Contentful, Sanity, etc.).

- 
Experience configuring website analytics/marketing platform integrations such as with Google Analytics and HubSpot.

- 
Experience with developer-facing products or startups.

Team, values & benefits 

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page .

reasons: stack match: aws, next.js, node.js, react, typescript
