title: Signalling Security Specialist
description:
About the Role

As a Telecom Signalling Security Analyst , you will combine customer-facing delivery with hands-on technical execution in sensitive telecom environments.

You will:

- Support and operate P1 Security solutions in production contexts (notably PTM and VKB ).

- Conduct signalling security audits using proprietary tooling (notably PTA ) and deliver rigorous, professional reports and presentations to customers.

This is a profile-focused role: we are looking for someone who can cover both audit delivery and operational support.

Our teams are remote-first, with a preference for candidates who can overlap working hours with Central European Time.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities

- Customer delivery & communication 

- Act as a technical point of contact for customers: scoping, updates, and delivery.

- Deliver presentations, training, and debrief sessions.

- Signalling Security Audits (PTA) 

- Contribute to audit scoping (objectives, perimeter, constraints, timelines, deliverables).

- Prepare safe execution plans and operational safeguards.

- Execute signalling security audits using PTA and associated tooling in a controlled manner.

- Analyze results, validate findings, and assess exploitability/root cause.

- Draft professional technical reports in English and present findings to customers.

- PTM operations & IT support (ticket management) 

- Provide IT support for the PTM IDS in the context of customer ticket workflows.

- Troubleshoot and maintain PTM deployments, including Linux and virtualization layers.

- Operate and improve day-to-day tooling/scripts used for investigations, maintenance, and deployments.

- Collaboration & continuous improvement 

- Work closely with Engineering and R&D to improve tooling, detection quality, and operational processes.

- Maintain clear internal documentation and handover notes.

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications

- Technical writing (English) : ability to draft professional, structured technical reports and slide decks

- Client communication : strong verbal communication skills for presenting and interacting directly with customers.

- Telecom core & roaming security : solid understanding of telecom core architecture, roaming concepts, and where signalling security fits in real operator environments.

- Signalling protocols & call flows (hands-on) : ability to read and reason about SS7/SIGTRAN, Diameter, LTE/IMS and GTP-C call flows, and connect traces/observations to concrete security findings.

- Standards-driven audit mindset : familiarity with GSMA Fraud & Security standards (notably FS.11, FS.19, FS.20 ) and ability to translate requirements into test cases, evidence collection, and actionable remediation.

- Roaming signalling security : mastery of roaming signalling attacks and call flows.

- Linux / terminal : comfortable using a terminal and basic Linux commands.

- Scripting 

- Python : Proficiency in "quick scripting" mode : Ability to develop one-off analysis or testing scripts. No expectations regarding software architecture or code maintainability

- Bash / shell scripting : ability to write and maintain scripts for operational needs.

- Virtualization / operations : experience with Linux + ESXi / VM operations (deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance) is a plus

- Soft skills : customer centered, autonomy, high level of rigor, proactive mindset (ability to propose solutions).

Hiring Process

- Initial contact call (10–20 minutes)

- Call with the hiring manager (30 minutes)

- Capability assessment (role-specific exercise)

- Final interview with C-Level and directors (30 minutes)

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Argentina Remote

Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

About the Role 

We’re looking for a S enior Infrastructure Engineer to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month.

- Location: Remote-first (Argentina)

- Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position)

- Application Information:

- Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled

- This posting is for a new position.

As an Senior Infrastructure Engineer you will:

- Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP.

- Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on.

- Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments.

- Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy.

- Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation.

- Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence.

About you 

You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you:

- Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems. 

- Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime.

- Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like.

- Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle.

- Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles.

- Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP.

- Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following:

- Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling.

- Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana

- Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance.

- Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing.

You Are:

- Collaborative : You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners.

- Strategic thinker : You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions.

- Comfortable with ambiguity : You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements.

If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

Our Core Behaviors: 

- Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

- Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

- Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

- Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits 

- Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

- Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

- Support for every stage of family life . 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

- Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

- Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

- Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. 

- Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.

- Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment. 

Remote, together 

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected 

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog , LinkedIn , X (Twitter) , and/or Glassdoor . 

Please note: 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered. 

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment. 

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes. 

For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice .

title: Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales - German Defense & Intelligence
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. 

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role: 

As a Pre-Sales Solutions Architect, you'll design complex solutions to demonstrate the value of Planet's data and services to help organizations within the German Defense and Intelligence community overcome their earth data challenges. You'll collaborate with internal cross-functional teams, including Customer Success, Product Management, and Business Development, to act as the voice of the customer and enhance Planet's industry offerings.

Ideal candidates are dedicated to earth observation and enabling customer success across complex technical projects.

This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week. 

Impact You’ll Own: 

- Build and deliver presentations and product demonstrations highlighting technical capabilities of Planet’s platform and our ability to fulfill customer’s business needs.

- Build relationships with customers’ technical and management staff as a trusted advisor to their business.

- Act as a technical advisor to the customer to recommend a solutions architecture that fits their business challenges.

- Craft the technical response to tenders, RFI’s/RFP’s, and unsolicited proposals with respect to Planet’s products and solutions.

- Partner with your sales team colleagues to architect and drive the technical strategy across customer and prospect account plans. 

- Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams including Customer Success, Product Management, and Business Development to act as the voice of the customer, assist with RFP and RFI preparation and submissions. 

- Attain quarterly and annual sales and operational objectives assigned by management.

- Represent the needs of Planet's Defense and Intelligence customers to Sales leadership by communicating forecasts, pipeline opportunities, deal reviews, CRM data, and customer feedback. 

- Present to key executive Government stakeholders within the German Government 

- Mentors junior team members and contributes to team training materials.

What You Bring: 

- 6+ years of experience supporting the German Defense and Intelligence community in a technical capacity.

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.

- Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 25%.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in the German language.

- Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.

- Experience working with GIS and Remote Sensing users within the Defense industry.

- Experience in IMINT, ISR, and related fields.

- Experience with QGIS, SocetGXP, ArcGIS, GDAL, Python, and other geospatial software packages and programming languages.

- Experience designing and presenting complex systems and solutions that bridge the gap between business problems and technology to meet organizational goals, budget, and scalability needs.

- Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Ability to process imagery, manipulate geospatial data, interact with APIs, and build data pipelines.

- Obtaining and maintaining eligibility for a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) is required.

What Makes You Stand Out: 

- Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively in a dynamic environment.

- Experience leading technical customer engagements and leading workshops or training sessions with users.

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

This position requires access to U.S. and German/EU export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by German, EU, or U.S. authorities.

title: (Senior) Integration Engineer, ERP (Oracle)
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 

About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

What you’ll do

- Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.

- Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.

- Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

- Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

- Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.

- Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

What you'll bring

- Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

- Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

- Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).

- NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.

- JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.

- A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

- Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.

- A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

- Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have: 

- Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).

- Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

- Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

- Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer

We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

Integration Engineer 

- Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.

- Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.

- Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

Senior Integration Engineer 

- Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

- Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.

- Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.

- Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

Why BLP 

- Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

- Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

- Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

- Team: regular team events.

Practical information

- Location: our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.

- If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.

- Employment: full-time, permanent.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. 

Location: Oxford, England, UK
Working pattern: Hybrid

Role: 

We are looking for a Senior Silicon Validation Engineer to join our Cryo-CMOS IC team at IonQ Oxford. You will lead the validation and characterisation of analogue and mixed-signal ASICs for our trapped-ion quantum processors, from test planning and platform development through first-silicon bring-up, debug and system integration.

This is a hands-on technical role. You will shape our validation architecture, build reusable hardware and software, and provide the evidence needed to make confident silicon acceptance decisions. The work includes room-temperature silicon validation and silicon characterisation at cryogenic temperatures (around 4 kelvin), on packaged parts, chip-on-board assemblies and bare die on a cryogenic probe station.

Responsibilities: 

You will own validation delivery across chip and system interfaces, working closely with analogue and digital design, verification, modelling, firmware and systems engineers. You will turn requirements into measurable tests, prepare platforms before silicon arrives and resolve failures across the chip, board and software.

As a Senior engineer, you will set technical standards, guide other engineers and improve coverage, repeatability and test efficiency across successive ASIC generations.

Key responsibilities include:

- 
Own the silicon validation strategy, plans, acceptance criteria and readiness reviews, with traceability from block and system requirements to tests, results and unresolved risks.

- 
Present the silicon acceptance report to the Cryo-CMOS IC Lead and programme stakeholders.

- 
Lead first-silicon bring-up and characterisation of sample-and-hold and switch arrays, DACs, ADCs, references, amplifiers, switches, regulators, clocking and device-level test structures, across supply, temperature, operating modes and device variation, with sound calibration and measurement uncertainty.

- 
Develop validation boards, fixtures and reusable Python automation, instrument drivers and regression suites, addressing signal integrity, grounding, power integrity and measurement access, with version-controlled tests and reproducible data analysis.

- 
Plan and lead cryogenic measurements with specialist colleagues, including bare-die probing and the cold signal chain, and drive failures to root cause, separating silicon defects from board, firmware and test artefacts and correlating results with simulations, device models and foundry or partner data.

- 
Influence testability before tape-out, coordinate validation with external design partners, the foundry and other IonQ sites.

- 
Lead technical reviews, mentor engineers and document methods to improve throughput, data quality and reuse.

Requirements: 

You will bring substantial experience in analogue or mixed-signal silicon validation and characterisation, with ownership of multiple silicon bring-up programmes. A degree in electrical or electronic engineering, or equivalent practical experience, is expected. You should combine hands-on laboratory skills with sound judgement on test coverage, measurement confidence and programme risk.

You’d be a great fit with:

- 
Strong electronics fundamentals and experience validating precision signal chains, data converters or power-management circuits, including their digital control interfaces.

- 
Practical expertise with oscilloscopes, precision sources and meters, signal generators, spectrum and logic analysers; confidence designing reliable low-noise, low-leakage measurements.

- 
Strong Python programming for instrument control, automated testing and statistical analysis; disciplined use of Git or equivalent version control and maintainable test software.

- 
Experience designing and debugging test PCBs, reviewing layouts and working with interfaces such as SPI, I2C, JTAG and custom shift-register chains, alongside embedded firmware or FPGA-based platforms.

- 
A record of resolving complex chip, board and software interactions through structured experiments and collaboration.

- 
Experience leading technical projects, mentoring engineers and communicating evidence, uncertainty and decisions in clear written reports.

Useful additional experience includes cryogenic or other extreme-temperature testing; wafer or bare-die probing; early-stage IP or test-chip evaluation; FPGA development and C/C++; circuit simulation; and production test correlation. Prior quantum computing is welcome but not required.

Benefits: 

Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We offer more than just a role, you’ll join a world class community of scientists, engineers and innovators working to unlock the full potential of quantum computing.

We offer a range of benefits, including opportunities to further your career alongside industry leaders, a competitive salary with IonQ stock options, an annual performance bonus, generous annual leave, flexible hybrid working, private medical and dental insurance for you and your family, and much more.

Join us and be part of the future of quantum computing.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. title: Senior Principal Solution Engineer
description:
Strength in Trust 

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society. 

The Challenge 

We’re looking for a Senior Principal Solutions Engineer to shape and lead technical strategy for OneTrust’s most strategic and complex opportunities in the UK & Ireland. Reporting to the Solutions Engineering Manager, you will bring broad portfolio fluency, deep enterprise technology expertise, executive-level customer engagement, and commercial judgement to help customers solve business-critical challenges with OneTrust.

You will partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and partners to build deep account alignment, progress complex buying decisions, and create measurable customer and commercial outcomes. You will be a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders and a force multiplier for the Solutions Engineering organisation: setting s high bar, developing reusable approaches, and coaching others to raise the quality of our work. AI Governance is an important area of expertise for this role, alongside the breadth to lead opportunities across OneTrust’s entire platform.

Your Mission 

- Lead technical strategy for the highest-impact, most complex opportunities across OneTrust’s solutions portfolio, aligning the customer’s business priorities, technology environment, risk posture, architecture and decision process to the right OneTrust solutions and measurable outcomes. Bring particular depth in AI Governance where relevant to the customer’s needs.

- Build deep account alignment with Account Executives, Customer Success and other partners. Map the buying group and executive sponsors; understand account priorities and whitespace; and shape a coordinated, multi-stakeholder motion that advances the opportunity and contributes to sustainable ACV growth. Partner with the commercial account owners on expansion strategy; this role does not replace their ownership of the customer relationship.

- Engage credibly with executive and practitioner stakeholders—including CIO/CTO, CISO, Chief AI and Data leaders, Privacy, Legal, Risk, Security, Procurement, and AI/ML Engineering—to connect governance requirements with business value and delivery realities.

- Lead discovery and solution design for complex enterprise programmes across relevant OneTrust solution areas, translating fragmented requirements, regulatory obligations and technical constraints into practical, scalable operating models, architectures and workflows.

- Bring deep technical expertise in OneTrust’s solutions, enterprise integrations and the technology ecosystems relevant to each opportunity. Advise on APIs, data flows, identity and access, cloud and platform architecture, and—where relevant—AI/ML lifecycles and operational controls; identify risks and dependencies early; and recommend implementable designs.

- Lead tailored demonstrations, technical evaluations, proofs of concept, RFP responses and executive presentations across the portfolio. Set clear success criteria, prove technical fit and business value, and use evaluation outcomes to build stakeholder confidence and progress the sales motion.

- Articulate OneTrust’s differentiated value and position solutions thoughtfully against alternatives, connecting customer requirements to the most relevant solution capabilities, integrations and roadmap—including AI Governance where applicable—without overpromising.

- Act as a strategic bridge between the field and Product, Engineering, Marketing and leadership. Bring structured customer and competitive insight to inform product direction, positioning, packaging and go-to-market strategy.

- Create reusable solution patterns, account-planning practices, demos, technical guidance and field assets that improve consistency and outcomes beyond an individual opportunity.

- Coach and mentor Solutions Engineers and cross-functional partners in portfolio knowledge, strategic discovery, technical storytelling, executive engagement and complex deal execution, sharing AI Governance expertise where relevant.

- Maintain accurate opportunity strategy, technical risks, evaluation plans and next steps in Salesforce, in partnership with the account team.

What Success Looks Like 

- You are a trusted technical and strategic partner on the business’s most consequential opportunities across OneTrust’s solutions portfolio, improving deal progression and technical win outcomes.

- You build durable alignment across customer executives, practitioners and the OneTrust account team, connecting the right OneTrust solutions to funded priorities and demonstrable business value—including AI Governance where relevant.

- Your work contributes to healthy ACV growth by helping account teams identify, shape and win the right strategic opportunities.

- Customers see a credible path from their business priorities to operational outcomes, with connected, secure, scalable and realistic recommendations across the relevant OneTrust solutions.

- You raise the capability of the wider organisation through thought leadership, repeatable approaches, coaching and actionable customer insight.

You Are 

- A strategic, customer-led thinker who starts with outcomes and discovery, navigates ambiguity, and exercises sound judgement rather than defaulting to a product pitch or a standard playbook.

- Commercially astute: you understand how complex enterprise buying decisions are made, how technical strategy affects deal outcomes, and how to create mutual value without compromising customer trust.

- An executive-level communicator who can move from technical depth to a concise business narrative, influence senior decision-makers, and adapt to different audiences.

- A broad portfolio strategist and a credible AI Governance expert, with a strong, current point of view on the AI landscape, associated technologies and fast-moving developments. You continuously assess what is emerging, what is becoming operationally relevant, and what it means for customer needs and OneTrust’s solutions.

- A technical authority and generous coach: you are a go-to resource on complex problems and actively build the expertise and confidence of others.

- A cross-functional leader who influences through expertise, brings teams together across geographies, and turns customer and market insight into broader organisational impact.

- Comfortable setting direction where the answer is not yet established, while being transparent about assumptions, trade-offs, product capabilities and limitations.

Your Experience Includes 

- Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in Solutions Engineering, Solutions Consulting, technical sales or a comparable customer-facing enterprise technology role, including a track record of leading complex, strategic opportunities.

- Demonstrated success shaping strategic sales motions through deep account alignment, executive engagement, multi-threaded discovery and value-based solution design—with evidence of contributing to ACV growth and technical wins.

- Experience across multiple enterprise solution areas, ideally spanning OneTrust domains such as privacy, AI Governance, data use governance, technology risk and compliance, third-party risk, and consent and preferences. You can connect solution areas into coherent customer outcomes; AI Governance is a required area of depth, but not the exclusive scope of the role.

- Deep expertise in AI Governance and responsible AI, including practical understanding of AI system inventories, governance operating models, risk assessment, policy and controls, approvals, evidence and ongoing oversight.

- Strong knowledge of AI technologies and architectures, including generative AI and large language models, AI agents, machine learning, third-party AI, model and application lifecycles, and the cloud services and platforms used to build and operate AI. You can assess new developments critically and translate their implications into customer guidance.

- Working knowledge of relevant governance and regulatory frameworks, such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001, and the ability to connect requirements to operational processes and technical controls.

- Strong technical grounding in enterprise SaaS, cloud computing, web applications, REST APIs, enterprise integrations, authentication and data flows. Experience with JavaScript or Python and practical scripting is valuable; familiarity with containers and Kubernetes is an advantage.

- Experience designing and delivering enterprise software demonstrations, integrations and evaluations, including proofs of concept with clear business and technical success criteria.

- The ability to build trusted relationships and influence across customer organisations and internal teams, including Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Marketing and partners.

- A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Willingness to travel as required; estimated travel is approximately 25%.

Where we Work 

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits 

As an employee at OneTrust , you will be part of the OneTeam . That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers. 

Resources 

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people: 

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube 

- @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram 

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview . You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form .

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. title: Commercial Data Scientist
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)

Commercial Data Scientist 

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. 

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S. 

As a Commercial Data Scientist , you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare.

How you’ll make an impact: 

- Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies.

- Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights & Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.

- Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects.

- Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.

- Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations

The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team 

As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.

- Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

- Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.

- Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.

- Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.

- Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.

About you: 

- At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets.

- Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment

- Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory.

- Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques

- Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

- Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships.

- Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries.

- Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training.

- Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders.

- Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research.

Fun Facts About the Client Intelligence team 

- We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.

- Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.

- The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.

- We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!

Compensation 

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Our total compensation package may include:

- Base salary

- Equity (where applicable)

- Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits 

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance

- 401(k) with company match

- Flexible paid time off and company holidays

- Paid parental leave

- Professional development and learning opportunities

- Wellness and mental health resources

- Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)

Why You'll Love Working Here 

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

- Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.

- Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.

- Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.

- Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.

- Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools 

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. 

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Market Data
description:
About Dune 

Dune's mission is to make onchain finance observable. We're the industry standard for onchain data: a blockchain data and intelligence provider that institutions, protocols, and analysts trust to understand the onchain world and the frontiers of finance. We deliver structured datasets, spanning stablecoins, RWAs, tokens, lending, trading, and more, from 130+ chains and counting, to 1,000+ industry leaders including Visa, WisdomTree, FINRA, the IMF, Bloomberg, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Forbes, and the Financial Times.

We're a tight knit team of ~50 hard working people, spread across Europe and eastern US timezones ️, having an outsized impact on the industry. We take pride in being ambitious and doing world class work while staying humble and lighthearted. We believe in building open, verifiable data that lets individuals and institutions do deep research into ecosystems like Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood and many more.

We're backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that let us double down on our mission.

If you like being challenged and want to work together with a brilliant team on an important mission, come join us.

Learn more about us: 

About Dune
https://dune.com/about 

Values and working at Dune

https://dune.com/careers 

About the role 

Dune is building market data solutions for institutional customers who need timely, accurate and reliable financial data they can depend on. Our team turns onchain activity into realtime feeds and associated reference data along with historical data capture.

You will work on our new market data platform, and help shape how it evolves to support the growing features and customer base. You’ll design systems that can grow across chains, protocols and product capabilities while making clear decisions about correctness, latency, reliability, and cost.

This is a hands-on Staff Engineer role. You will be expected to turn ambiguous requirements into designs and deliverable work, implement difficult parts yourself, and help other engineers own meaningful parts of the platform. AI-assisted development is a core part of how we expect you to work, paired with strong engineering judgment and ownership of what you ship.

In this role you will 

- 
Design and build distributed systems for ingestion, normalization, processing, storage, and delivery of realtime market data from blockchain and other relevant sources.

- 
Build and operate streaming solutions that handle event ordering, timestamps, duplicates, replay, gaps, and recovery, including blockchain reorganizations and finality where they affect customer data.

- 
Build reliable client feeds and APIs with clear delivery contracts, schema evolution, access controls, and predictable behavior under load or when consumers fall behind.

- 
Partner with teams across Dune on reference data models and historical data capture.

- 
Define and improve service objectives and data quality measures.

- 
Instrument latency, freshness, completeness, and correctness, and turn incidents into lasting improvements in recovery and operations.

- 
You will debug independently and drive root cause analysis to a fix that holds.

- 
Own services through deployment and production support, including participation in the team’s on-call rotation.

- 
Use AI throughout development: explore designs, implement changes, build tests, investigate failures, and improve documentation. Develop repeatable workflows and share what works with the team.

- 
Lead technical decisions across team boundaries, write clear designs, and mentor engineers through implementation and review.

You might be a great fit if 

- 
You have built and operated distributed backend or data services with demanding reliability and performance requirements. You understand their failure modes and can debug problems across service and data boundaries.

- 
You have experience with realtime streaming systems, including concurrency, state management, backpressure, and recovery. You care about data correctness, from timestamps and numeric precision to schema changes and corrections.

- 
You have strong computer science fundamentals and backend engineering skills. Experience in Rust, Go or comparable languages is also valuable.

- 
You turn ambiguous requirements into pragmatic designs and production services, and help other engineers deliver parts of the solution.

- 
You communicate clearly in writing and work effectively with a distributed team.

- 
Financial or market data experience at a financial institution.

Not required but a plus 

- 
Onchain data experience: blockchain indexing such as with EVM or Solana.

- 
Reference data experience: instrument and entity masters, identifier mapping, effective-dated records, or tokenized asset and fund data.

- 
Experience at a company where the data is the product.

Perks & Benefits 

- 
A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space

- 
Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window

- 
5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you) 

- 
A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day 

- 
Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!

- 
Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
description:
Senior Integrity Engineer 

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero 

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity .

Your team 

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters 

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like 

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

· Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

· Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

· Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

· Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

· Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

· Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

· Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves 

· A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

· At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

· Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

· Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

· Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

· Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

· Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

· Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

· You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

· You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves 

· Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

· Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

· Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

· Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

· Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

· Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero 

· Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

· Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

· Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

· International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

· Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis. 

What we offer 

· A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

· A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

· Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

· Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.

Application process 

1. Introductory interview with our recruiter.
2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

We would like the new colleague to start as soon as possible. Interested? Apply via the button below with your CV and a short motivation. For questions, please contact Veroniek Smits, our Corporate Recruiter, at 

Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Machine Learning Engineer - IV (Computer Vision)
description:
Headquarters: India (remote)

Machine Learning Engineer IV – (Computer Vision) 

We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. You’ll build and train models, and own ML systems end-to-end on AWS. The final job level for this role will be determined following the interview process.

What You’ll Do 

- Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)

- Rigorous fairness analysis and benchmarking of biometric models across various datasets and operating conditions.

- Architect, train, and optimize models using PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or JAX

- Own and evolve end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to deployment. Design automated pipelines (Airflow) for data ingestion and cleaning. You will be responsible for curating balanced training sets and generating synthetic data to address both quality and diversity gaps.

- Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.

- Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.

What We’re Looking For 

- Strong industry experience in Machine Learning, dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.

- Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.

- Fairness & Ethics: You understand the sources of algorithmic bias in Computer Vision and have practical experience measuring and mitigating disparate impact.

- Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.

- Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.

- Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).

Nice to Have 

- Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.

- Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.

- Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.

- Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.

- Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.

- Strong communication skills.

Jumio Values: 

IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation 

Equal Opportunities : 

Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses. 

About Jumio: 

Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders. 

Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

Applicant Data Privacy 

We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com .

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-machine-learning-engineer-iv-computer-vision

title: Director, Engineering, Platform/Services
description:
About Life360 

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. 

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. 

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

Our Services engineering teams, part of our Quality and Scale Pillar, build and run the systems every Life360 member relies on but never sees. We carry location data between members’ phones and our servers, deliver the push and SMS notifications that families depend on, verify who members are and what they can access, build and scale our business critical services and give partners a safe way to build on Life360. When we do our jobs well, product teams ship faster and families trust the app in the moments that matter most.

We are a group of backend, cloud, and mobile engineers who care about reliability, security, and scale, and who treat member trust as the foundation of everything we build.

About the Job

As a Director of Engineering, you will lead the teams building and operating Life360’s critical platforms, including location and messaging, cloud infrastructure and identity, and partner ecosystems. These systems are the foundation of the experiences millions of families rely on every day. You are a player coach who will set technical direction, develop strong engineering managers and technical leaders, and ensure our platforms are reliable, secure, and built to scale as Life360 grows to hundreds of millions of members worldwide.

This is a leadership role that combines deep technical judgment with business impact. You will anticipate scaling challenges before they become problems, modernize critical systems, and make thoughtful tradeoffs across reliability, performance, cost, and speed. You will partner closely with Product, Security, Data, and engineering leaders to connect technology investments to business outcomes, accelerate product innovation, and build an engineering organization that can deliver at scale.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $216,500 to $318,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 251,000 to 295,000 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. 

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. 

What You’ll Do

- Build the foundation for scale. Lead the engineering teams behind Life360’s critical services, including location and messaging, cloud and identity, and partner platforms. Build reliable, secure, and scalable systems that can support hundreds of millions of members around the world.

- See around corners. Anticipate architectural bottlenecks, reliability risks, and scaling challenges before they impact members. Set technical direction, modernize legacy systems, and balance near-term business needs with long-term platform investments.

- Make reliability a competitive advantage. Establish high standards for availability, performance, observability, security, and incident response. Build resilient systems that proactively detect and prevent failures, ensuring members can trust Life360 in the moments that matter most.

- Build a culture of ownership and accountability. Create an engineering organization where teams proactively identify problems, take responsibility for outcomes, and drive solutions without waiting for direction. Empower leaders to make decisions, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the bar for engineering excellence across organizational boundaries.

- Make the invisible visible. Establish meaningful engineering metrics across reliability, performance, cost, security, and developer productivity. Use data to identify risks, prioritize investments, and communicate platform health and business impact to senior leadership.

- Grow leaders who grow teams. Hire, coach, and develop engineering managers, staff engineers, and technical leaders. Build a high-performing organization with clear accountability, strong technical judgment, and leaders who can make decisions and deliver outcomes independently.

- Accelerate the entire engineering organization. Build reusable services, APIs, and platforms that reduce duplication and enable product teams to ship faster. Expand our partner ecosystem through secure, scalable integrations that make it easier to build on Life360.

- Turn engineering investments into business outcomes. Connect technical strategy to member experience, product velocity, and business performance. Make deliberate tradeoffs across reliability, scalability, cost, and speed, and use meaningful metrics to demonstrate impact and inform investment decisions.

- Lead through influence. Partner across Product, Security, Data, and Engineering to align priorities, resolve ambiguity, and drive cross-functional decisions. Translate company strategy into actionable engineering roadmaps while bringing technical risks and tradeoffs to senior leadership.

- Stay close to the technology and embrace what’s next. Engage in architectural reviews and critical technical decisions, challenge assumptions, and empower teams to make pragmatic tradeoffs. Champion AI-assisted development, automation, and modern engineering practices to improve productivity, quality, and speed.

What We’re Looking For

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams, with experience managing managers.

- Track record of leading backend or platform engineering at high scale, with distributed systems serving millions of users. B2B or B2C platform experience is welcome.

- Demonstrated success developing and coaching managers, including former individual contributors who grew into leadership.

- Experience translating company strategy into technical plans, and representing your teams’ needs back to senior leaders.

- Experience modernizing legacy systems with respect for the history behind them, and the judgment to change what needs changing rather than everything.

- Strong cross-functional partnership skills, with a record of resolving ownership and priority conflicts directly.

- Hands-on technical credibility in cloud infrastructure and distributed systems (AWS experience preferred).

- Excellent written and verbal communication.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Our Benefits

- Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.

- 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.

- Paid parental leave.

- Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.

- Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.

- Learning & Development programs.

- Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.

- Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference 

- Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. 

- Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.

- Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. 

- High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. 

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status. 

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

title: Engineering Internships 2027
description:
About Nabla 

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

Early Careers: Software Engineering & Machine Learning 

We’re looking for early-career engineers who want to learn fast, work with experienced mentors, and make a real impact from day one. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-driven team where technical curiosity and humility matter as much as skill.

Location: Paris (Hybrid)

Start Date: 2027 (or as early as possible)

Commitment: Internship-to-hire

What we Offer 

- Real Impact from Day One: You won’t be stuck with small tasks: you’ll contribute to real features and products.

- Learning Everywhere: We believe in mentorship, pair programming, and leveling up together.

- Lean, Ambitious Team: Be part of a fast-moving, deeply technical culture where your contributions matter.

- Healthcare Mission: Help doctors, nurses, and care teams spend more time with Patients

- Career Launchpad: Many interns convert to full-time, and early engineers grow quickly.

We work across multiple domains: 

- Apps: Web app, frontend logic, UI/UX

- Platform: Backend services, infrastructure, APIs

- Core (ML): Algorithms, models, data systems

Your DNA 

- Currently pursuing or recently graduated in Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, or a related field .

- Comfortable coding in at least one: Java, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript .

- Passionate about AI, data, or building meaningful product features.

- Curious, collaborative, and excited to learn.

- Humble and resilient — you ask questions, take feedback, and grow.

Nice-to-Haves (but not required) 

- Internship or personal projects in AI, full-stack, or backend systems.

- Experience with React, GraphQL, or cloud infrastructure.

- Knowledge of CI/CD, Docker, or automated testing.

You’ll see us on campus at: 

- Télécom Paris

- Forum Trium

- ENSIMAG

- CentraleSupélec

- École Polytechnique

- EPFL

- Forum Organisation

Meet us there and tell us what excites you. 

Life at Nabla 

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness.
