title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

- Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events

- Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them

- Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading

- Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise

- Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible

- Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales

- Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models

- Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper

- Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems

- Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge

No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.

What Success Looks Like

Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.

- Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning

- No active backlogs

- Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++

- Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects

- Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking

- A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly

Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.

Our Culture

More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.

At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.

Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.

AI & Automation stage beschikbaar! 
Ben jij een sportgek? Wil je graag in een dynamische en sportieve werkomgeving AI & Automation stage-ervaring op doen? En zoek je per februari 2027 een AI & Automation stage? Dan ben je bij P1 Travel in Leiden aan het goede adres. Wij hebben namelijk een stageplek beschikbaar in het AI-team. 

Dit is P1

P1 Travel is het grootste sportevenementen Ticketing bureau van Europa en wij werken officieel samen met de grootste voetbalclubs, stadions en toernooien ter wereld. Denk aan clubs als Manchester United, Tottenham Hotspur, FC Barcelona en West Ham united, maar ook de Olympische spelen, Formule 1 en Wimbledon. Wij brengen zakelijke en particuliere klanten naar het evenement van hun dromen. Jij kunt hier onderdeel van uitmaken in de vorm van een stage bij ons Finance team. Feeling met sport? Dan wordt deze stage je grootste hobby! 

Hoe gaat je stage eruitzien? 
In deze rol werk je samen met verschillende afdelingen om operationele behoeften te identificeren, te begrijpen hoe teams werken, en die inzichten te vertalen naar praktische automatiseringsoplossingen en AI-agents. 

Als AI & Automation Intern ondersteun je de ontwikkeling van tools die de efficiëntie binnen het bedrijf verbeteren, van workflows in Power Automate tot AI-agents gebouwd in Microsoft Foundry en script-gebaseerde oplossingen. Deze helpen medewerkers om informatie te raadplegen, content te genereren, documenten te verwerken en repetitieve taken efficiënter uit te voeren. Je werkt nauw samen met teams zoals Finance, HR, Operations, Partnerships, Marketing en Ticketing om hun dagelijkse processen te begrijpen en te bepalen waar automatisering echte waarde kan toevoegen. 

Een belangrijk onderdeel van de functie is goed begrijpen hoe elke afdeling werkt. Dat betekent de juiste vragen stellen, assertief zijn in het verzamelen van de informatie die je nodig hebt, en gedurende elk project duidelijk blijven communiceren met stakeholders. 

Deze rol is geschikt voor iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar bedrijfsprocessen, zelfverzekerd communiceert met verschillende stakeholders, en gedreven is om eigenaarschap te nemen van idee tot implementatie. De functie combineert technische interesse met sterke projectmanagementvaardigheden: je verzamelt relevante informatie, structureert workflows, bouwt oplossingen, test de resultaten, verbetert deze op basis van feedback, en traint eindgebruikers zodat de automatiseringen en agents goed worden geadopteerd zodra ze live staan. 

Jouw profiel 

- Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding (bijv. bedrijfskunde, informatica, information management, AI of een vergelijkbare richting) en bent beschikbaar voor een meewerkstage. 

- Je hebt technische affiniteit en leert snel nieuwe tools. Ervaring met Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry of scripten (bijv. Python) is een pré, maar belangrijker is dat je gemotiveerd bent om je hierin te verdiepen. 

- Je denkt gestructureerd en projectmatig: je kunt een vraagstuk opknippen, workflows in kaart brengen en prioriteiten stellen. 

- Je communiceert helder en zelfverzekerd, zowel in het ophalen van behoeften als in het meenemen en trainen van gebruikers. 

- Naast Nederlands beheers je ook de Engelse taal. 

- Mooi meegenomen als je zelf ook een passie hebt voor sport, dat hebben wij namelijk ook! 

Waar kom je terecht? 

We zijn gevestigd in het mooie Leiden en je komt terecht in een gezellig én ambitieus bedrijf waar geen dag hetzelfde is. We bestaan momenteel uit een groep van 70 collega’s en werken elk semester met een leuke groep van stagiaires verdeeld over verschillende afdelingen. title: Principal MEMS Development Engineer

SiTime Corporation is the precision timing company. Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power and better reliability. Join the team that is revolutionizing the timing industry with the best silicon Microelectromechanical Systems (MEMS) timing products in the world. It is not necessary to meet all job requirements to be a qualified candidate for the position.

Responsibilities: 

- Lead definition and execution of challenging technical projects.

- Develop new or improved resonators, MEMS technologies and/or products.

- Extend and enhance automated infrastructure for MEMS design, measurements, and data analysis.

- Ph.D. in ME, EE, Physics, or equivalent

- Excellent interpersonal, organizational, written and verbal communication skills.

- Passion for delivering exceptional results.

Desired Characteristics & Attributes: 

- 3 -10 years of industry experience.

- Intermediate to advanced knowledge of programing languages, circuits, metrology equipment and methods.

- Experience with Statistical analysis and tools such as R or JMP.

- Knowledge in MEMS microfabrication.

At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.

https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ditto https://docs.ditto.live/home/about-ditto I've been obsessed with CRDTs since I first saw them at Strange Loop years ago, and I still can't quite believe I now get to work on them for a living — in some of the most challenging environments there are: disconnected, degraded, contested, out where the cloud isn't. If that's your kind of problem, come build with us. Ditto is the edge-native data platform that keeps distributed systems in sync when the network doesn't cooperate — an offline-first, CRDT-based layer syncing any device (phone, vehicle, sensor, server) over Bluetooth LE, P2P Wi-Fi, LAN, and tactical radio, with or without connectivity. Same core, commercial to defense; operationally deployed and network-agnostic. The problems are the fun kind: conflict-free replication with no server and no synchronized clock, multi-transport routing that never drops the connection, moving a coherent picture over links as thin as an HF radio shot, and human-in-the-loop robotics/autonomy where a detection may have to be physically carried by a moving node. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition.

What you’ll be doing

- Unlocking Visual Data: Building pipelines that can "read" complex documents, understanding layout, charts, and visual context using Vision-Language Models (GPT-4V, Claude 3.5) and Layout Analysis .

- Orchestrating Intelligence: Owning the application logic layer. You will use LangChain or LangGraph to build the agents and chains that query our data, reason about it, and generate responses.

- Native PDF Handling: Handling the messy reality of PDF processing (PyMuPDF, layout parsing) to preserve structure before the AI even sees it.

title: Head of Software Engineering
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

You'll be a player-coach — someone who still ships code but also owns the engineering roadmap, team structure, and technical direction. You'll translate company strategy into engineering priorities, make sure the right things get built in the right order, and help a small, high-output team scale without losing speed.

You'll lead a small, technical engineering team that leverages AI to build the software infrastructure for running our automated lab. Your job is to make it the best small engineering team in biotech, and grow it thoughtfully as we scale.

This is not a management-track role where you stop building. You'll stay hands-on, especially as AI agents reshape what a small engineering team can accomplish. We expect you to be deeply technical, opinionated about architecture, and actively shipping — while also being the person who ensures the whole engineering org is pointed in the right direction and moving fast.

Day-to-day, that can mean:

- Owning the engineering roadmap — deciding what to build, what to defer, and what to kill

- Setting technical direction and architecture across frontend, backend, data pipelines, and lab-hardware integration

- Shipping code yourself on the highest-leverage problems, not just reviewing it

- Hiring, growing, and setting the bar for a team that ships fast and holds quality high — our lab runs on this software, so when things break, real experiments fail and real customers are affected

- Building the team's AI-assisted development practices into a genuine speed advantage

- A genuine interest in biology. No background required, but our product is running biology experiments in the physical world and that should excite you.

title: Head of Finance
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

We are building the most automated lab in the world, and that does not stop at the bench. A company that AI agents can run experiments in has to automate everything around the experiment too — procurement, hiring, admin, and finance. Finance is one of the most automatable functions in any company and almost nobody has actually done it. We intend to.

That is the job: build an AI-powered finance stack. Our ledger, billing, cards and payroll all expose APIs, and we already close the books against them programmatically rather than by hand. You would take that much further, to where the model, the close, the cash view and the margin analysis largely run themselves, and your week goes on the decisions instead of the reconciliation.

You would be our first finance hire, and it is hands-on. You will build the forecast, run the close across two entities, own cash, and be the person who can say what a protein actually costs us to make.

What You'll Do

- Own the forecast. Both directions: bottom-up from lab capacity, throughput and price per protein, and top-down P&L, burn and runway.

- Own gross margin. What does an experiment actually cost us — DNA, reagents, consumables, instrument time, labour? Which products and which customers lose us money?

- Own pricing, with commercial. What we charge, why, and where the floor is. Pricing at a lab company is a finance question wearing a sales hat.

- Own the close. Group consolidation and intercompany management. Make it fast, make it correct, make it boring.

- Own cash. Bank and card accounts across Switzerland and the US, AP runs, AR collection, payment timing. Know where the money is and where it is going before anyone asks.

- Keep us compliant. Tax, VAT, audit, payroll, and the external firms we work with. You are not a lawyer or an accountant, but you know when to call one.

- Investor reporting, fundraising support, and treasury management. 

- Equipment leasing and asset management. The lab runs on millions of francs of instruments. Lease or buy, how we finance it, what it does to the balance sheet, and keeping the asset register honest as we expand.

- Automate all of the above. 

What We're Looking For

- You have built a finance function, not just worked in one. Several years in finance at a startup that actually scaled, and ideally you were early enough to have set things up rather than inherited them.

- You can build a real model. Not a template. A model that ties operational reality — throughput, yield, capacity, headcount — to cash, and that survives someone pulling on it.

- You write code, or you are visibly about to. SQL at minimum, Python ideally. This is the hard requirement most finance candidates will fail, and we mean it. We run on Claude Code across the company, and every system finance touches has an API behind it. The best version of this person automates their own function, writes their own tooling, and finds leverage the rest of us have not thought of. If your instinct is that finance is a spreadsheet-and-portal job, we will frustrate each other.

- You understand the cost structure of a physical business. Reagents, instruments, consumables, capex versus COGS, yield loss. Lab, hardware, or manufacturing backgrounds all translate. Pure SaaS finance does not, on its own.

- Swiss and European finance experience. VAT, social charges, employment law. A US entity alongside a Swiss one is a plus.

- Ambitious, and in it for the company. We want someone who intends to be running finance at a much larger Adaptyv in three years, and who cares about what we are building rather than the title on the door.

- Trustworthy with everything. Salaries, revenue, investor communications, board material. All of it crosses your desk.

Scope

We are a small company and nobody here has clean edges around their job. You will end up in the lab, in a room with a customer, and every so often doing something that is nobody's job simply because it needs doing.

The centre of gravity is the numbers: the model, the close, cash, margin, pricing, and the board pack. That is the part that is yours and the part we will judge the role on. Procurement is a separate hire and the two of you will be joined at the hip on cost, but the sourcing and the vendor relationships are not yours to run.

One thing it is not: a bookkeeping seat. The mechanical layer is handled, and if that is the job you want, this one will bore you.

Why This Role Is Interesting

Most first-finance-hires at a startup spend three years cleaning up a SaaS P&L. Here, the finance question and the product question are the same question: an automated lab is a machine for converting money into experimental data, and how efficiently it does that is literally the business. Deep learning transformed text and images but mostly skipped tables, which are still the data behind most clinical trials, financial models and scientific experiments. The reason is structural: no natural sequence, no spatial structure, no shared vocabulary across datasets, so the architectures and scaling laws behind LLMs don't transfer. Our approach: pre-train a transformer on millions of synthetic datasets sampled from causal-structure priors. The whole dataset goes in as context, predictions come out in one forward pass. No per-dataset training, no hyperparameter tuning, seconds instead of hours. TabPFN v2 was published in Nature and set a new state of the art; TabPFN-3 scales to 10M rows. 4M+ downloads, 8k+ GitHub stars, in production from liquid biopsy to rail maintenance. Code: https://github.com/PriorLabs/TabPFN Since July we're an independent lab inside SAP, with more than EUR 1B committed over four years. Models stay open, research stays public, same team and offices. Roles (most can sit in any of the three offices): - Technical Product Manager, Integrations: take every model release live across SAP (AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud), the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, and help decide which channels we build next. Reports to me, close to the code. - ML Engineer, Infrastructure: own multi-cluster GPU infra (Slurm on GCP today, multi-provider next), training performance and the tooling layer. We spend tens of millions per year on compute; you own that budget. - Research Scientist, Foundation Model: drive the model agenda - novel architectures, scaling from 10K to 1M+ samples, multimodal and causal directions. PhD plus top-venue publications, or equivalent. - Research Engineer, Foundation Model: same agenda from the engineering side. You design experiments, write the training and eval infra, and co-author the papers. - ML Engineer, Backend: design and scale the backend that serves and finetunes the models. Python/FastAPI, Terraform, K8s. - Full Stack Engineer, ML Platform: build the product end to end. TypeScript + Python, React/FastAPI/Postgres. Also hiring: Applied Scientist, Forward Deployed ML Engineer, Research Scientist (Foundational Data Science), PhD research interns, plus GTM and ops roles. 40+ people with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Jane Street, Goldman, G-Research, CERN. Led by Frank Hutter, advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Yann LeCun. Comp competitive with top AI labs. All roles and applications: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/prior-labs Questions welcome in the replies here.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents
description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. 

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. 

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role 

RevenueCat helps app developers manage subscriptions and make more money from them. Maybe you're an indie developer who doesn’t know what "conversion" even means, you just want your app to make money so you can keep building it. Or maybe you're a growth specialist at a company doing millions a month, and pricing experiments are already your whole job. Either way, you probably didn't get into this to spend your days staring at a dashboard. So we built two AI agents to do that work for you, or make you even sharper at it if you're already a pro.

Enter Rico. Rico watches over your subscription business and can help you make sense of it, and act on what it finds. Say your revenue dropped last week. You don't need to go digging through charts to find out why. Just ask Rico. It pulls the data, explains what happened in plain language, and shows you how you compare to similar apps. Then it can fix things itself, like setting up a new plan or restoring a customer's access, with you approving the change before it goes live. Run a pricing experiment and Rico will read the results for you and tell you which version is winning. There are so many things we want Rico to be able to do!

Then there's our AI Paywall Editor, a specialized agent to build and edit paywalls, the screen that asks someone to subscribe. Most developers are not designers, and a paywall that actually gets people to tap "subscribe" is harder to build than it looks, so the AI Paywall Editor helps you with that. Use it in our online editor, from the command line, or hook your own AI tools into it over MCP.

You can see both agents in action in our most recent product launch recap .

This is a role for engineers who've built advanced agents that do actual work , not just a thin wrapper around an LLM. You'll ship agentic features to thousands of developers, and you’ll shape the foundation everything else runs on: orchestration, tool execution, context management, evaluation and human-in-the-loop controls.

About You 

- 
You have 8+ years of experience shipping production systems.

- 
You've built agents that other people actually use and the systems around them: tool use, structured output, context management, evaluation, orchestration.

- 
You have strong backend fundamentals. You've built systems that need to be reliable, observable, and secure.

- 
You hold a high bar for quality and instinctively know which details matter, but also are discerning enough to cut scope when needed while still delivering value.

- 
You’re customer-obsessed: you imagine yourself as the developer, product manager, or marketer using the feature or experiencing the issue.

- 
You’re a builder, not an implementer: scoping, prioritizing, and driving rollout in partnership with our Product team. This isn’t a role where you check off items from a detailed specification.

- 
You can quickly familiarize yourself with code you didn't write yourself and improve it.

- 
You’re scrappy and biased toward shipping. You’d rather ship a good version today and iterate than wait to ship a perfect one next quarter.

- 
You communicate clearly, both in real-time and asynchronously. We’re a fully remote team, and how you write is as important as how you code.

- 
You’ve shipped meaningful user-facing features to production, monitored their usage and adoption, and improved them over time.

- 
You write high-quality, well-tested code, debug issues methodically, and help raise the engineering bar through thoughtful feedback and mentorship.

- 
You act like an founder:: you notice problems, propose improvements, and follow through fast.

- 
You're comfortable with ambiguity. This is an early stage product inside a growth stage company, and the architecture is still being figured out.

- 
You're self directed. You figure out what needs to be built, build it, and ship it.

- 
You are curious and stay current on AI tools and practices.

- 
You have a habit of sharing what you learn with others.

Ideally, you have: 

- 
Familiarity with subscription business models, app stores, or developer tools

- 
Experience with OpenAI/Anthropic APIs specifically

- 
Experience with observability frameworks (Langfuse, Langchain, etc.)

- 
Built Slack integrations

- 
Contributed to open source AI/ML tooling

- 
Maintained systems at scale

In the first month, you’ll: 

- 
Meet frequently with your team and manager to get up to speed

- 
Learn our tools, processes, and the subscription business concepts that shape our product

- 
Get familiar with our debugging tools, infrastructure, and overall architecture

- 
Ship your first project: a small feature that gets you into the codebase and shows you how the agents talk to RevenueCat's APIs

- 
Jump in early: fix bugs, ship small improvements, and weigh in on PRs

Within the first 3 months, you’ll: 

- 
Ship a medium sized project, ideally a new agentic feature that reaches tens of thousands of developers

- 
Understand the main product areas your team owns and how they work end to end

- 
Understand our current agent infrastructure, orchestration, the eval pipeline, the tool framework, and the trust and permissions layer, and have opinions on how to improve it

- 
Scope and work on projects on your own, from idea to post launch improvements

- 
Take part in code reviews, bug bashes, and technical discussions

Within the first 6 months, you’ll: 

- 
Become the go to engineer for certain focus areas

- 
Have made the agents measurably more reliable, faster, and capable

- 
Contribute to architecture discussions that affect more than just your team

- 
Mentor other engineers joining the team

- 
Talk directly with customers to understand how your work actually lands

- 
Debug issues across frontend, backend, and data. Communicate clearly during incidents and drive fixes that prevent repeats

- 
Learn the basics of incident response and join the on call rotation

Within the first 12 months, you’ll: 

- 
Have built infrastructure the rest of the team ships agents on top of

- 
Know all the major components of our system and be able to debug complex issues

- 
Write proposals and drive major architecture discussions

- 
Spec and architect large projects, gather feedback, and drive design validation and rollout plans

- 
Have made RevenueCat an AI native company in large part because you built the engine underneath it

- 
Have your own initiatives for improving our product and systems, grounded in real customer priorities

What we offer: 

- 
Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

- 
10-year window to exercise vested equity options

- 
A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

- 
4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

- 
Paid desk at a co-working space

- 
Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat 

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat , including tips to help you succeed.

More on how we work: 

-

- 
The values that guide how we work: Our Values 

-

-

Not a full-time seat. Engagement: Ongoing 1099 contract. Milestone prices are set against a frozen spec. This is not a full-time seat. First package: A fixed-price flows-and-kit package, about three weeks. After that, $50–75/hr as each product grows. Location: SF Bay Area, hybrid, with in-person working sessions for kickoff and reviews. Start: Immediately after selection. Level: Mid-level welcome. You work directly with the founding CTO. Early sessions are for breaking the product down together. After that, scope is deliverable by deliverable. ABOUT THE STUDIO:
We are a small Bay Area product studio. Several products, one stack, one visual language. You own the UX with us: who the user is, what they are trying to finish, what belongs on each screen, and what happens when it fails. Later products reuse the same tokens, components, and patterns so customers and our engineers are not learning a new UI every time. The products are B2B web apps: dashboards, media and content libraries, status views, and auth and access-gate states. The first product in the queue is a digital signage CMS. Store owners upload content, build playlists, pair outdoor Android screens from a phone, and see what is playing. The app is a mobile-first PWA. The screen on the sidewalk has its own states: setup QR, downloading, no content, and error. You take a real part in that breakdown. Bring a point of view on structure, priority, and what to cut. Sit with us and map the flows before the high-fidelity screens exist. When a familiar admin layout is the wrong job for the task, say so and show the alternative. The screens still have to ship. We start from a Tailwind UI / shadcn component kit. Buttons, inputs, tables, cards, and dialogs stay that anatomy, restyled with our brand: color, type, radius, and density. Page structure, hierarchy, and flow are yours. Every screen is composed from those components, with tokens that map to our Tailwind theme, so the frontend team builds from the system. FOR MORE DETAILS OR TO APPLY: https://vuetech.sh/careers

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://www.samsara.com/ 

About the role: 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

- You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

- You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

- You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

- Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

- Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

- Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

- Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

- Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

- Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

- Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

- Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

- Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

- Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

- Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

- A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$162,400 — $290,000 USD

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer

Who We Are 

At Yuno, we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by seasoned experts from the payments and tech industries, our technology provides access to leading payment capabilities, enabling companies to engage customers confidently and maintain global operations through seamless integrations. 

We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald's, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries. 

About The Role 

We are orchestrating the best high-performing team! 

We are looking for a Technical Account Manager to own and elevate Yuno's technical customer relationships across Latin America. This is a leadership position for someone who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to inspire a team, build trust with customers, and drive outcomes that matter. You will be the senior technical voice for our most strategic accounts in the region â and the person who sets the standard for how great technical partnership looks at Yuno. 

Day to day, you will lead a team of TAMs while staying close to the most complex customer challenges yourself. LATAM is one of the fastest-growing payment ecosystems in the world, with unique local nuances and high-stakes integrations. That environment rewards people who bring both precision and resilience â someone who can stay steady under pressure, push through hard problems, and come out the other side with better solutions and stronger customer relationships than before. 

This role also sits at the heart of Yuno's cross-functional engine. You will work closely with Product, Development, Sales, and Partnerships teams, making sure customer insights translate into real improvements and that internal teams have the context they need to move fast. You will set best practices, define how the TAM function scales, and ensure every integration your team owns reflects the quality and reliability Yuno's customers expect. 

If you are technically sharp, and genuinely excited about building something meaningful in one of the most dynamic payment markets in the world â this role is for you. 

Your contribution will be 

- 
Serve as the senior technical point of contact for strategic accounts, owning escalations and driving resolution on complex integration challenges 

- 
Lead high-level discussions with customer leadership around technical strategy, product trade-offs, incident management, and risk mitigation 

- 
Define and implement best practices for technical onboarding, integration delivery, and ongoing account health monitoring 

- 
Build deep knowledge of each customer's business model, technical stack, and operational needs to proactively unlock value 

- 
Partner with developers and senior engineers to provide strategic technical guidance and support solution design 

- 
Collaborate with Product and Development teams to customize platform capabilities and feed customer insights into the roadmap 

- 
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Partnerships, and Finance to support account retention and regional growth 

- 
Monitor integration progress and ramp-up milestones across the team, ensuring consistent and high-quality delivery 

- 
Champion the LATAM customer base internally, bringing regional intelligence into Yuno's strategic conversations 

Skills You Need 

Minimum Qualifications 

- 
Fluency in English and Portuguese is a plus ; Spanish is a plus 

- 
5+ years of experience in technical account management or integration engineering, preferably in fintech or payments 

- 
Proven track record of leading or mentoring technical teams 

- 
Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML, and API management tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or Swagger 

- 
Proficiency in web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, RESTful APIs, and modern frameworks 

- 
Hands-on experience in at least one server-side language: Golang, Python, Node.js, or equivalent 

- 
Familiarity with server and database technologies including Apache, Nginx, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar 

- 
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills 

- 
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, team priorities, and concurrent projects 

- 
Clear and compelling communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all seniority levels 

- 
Experience with ticketing systems is a plus 

What We Offer at Yuno 

- 
Competitive Compensation 

- 
Remote Work â You can work from everywhere! 

- 
Home Office Bonus â A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office. 

- 
Work Equipment 

- 
Stock Options 

- 
Health Plan wherever you are. 

- 
Flexible Days Off

description:
fractile.ai - AI hardware, backed by Founders Fund - London (UK) - Onsite ABOUT FRACTILE
Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the amount of time they take to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. We’ve recently raised $220M from Founders Fund and Accel and the most important work lies ahead. Come and join the mission! THE ROLE
As a Software Engineer you will be a core part of our technical team working alongside the hardware, software and research teams to solve cutting-edge problems in AI hardware, ranging from verification to simulation, alongside the best of the best (DeepMind, Apple, Meta…). ABOUT YOU
1) You have exceptional ability. We look for pivotal IC contributions that solved the hardest problems in big tech companies or hedge funds; competitive hackathons, International Olympiad medals, or rank highly in other competitions like advent of code 2. You are a top engineer. We are not looking for specific languages or technologies - you will be a master of several, you excel at algorithmic skills and solving problems logically in any programming language. And you are very comfortable learning new skills on the fly. You like to work in Python and C++ 3. It’s likely you have several years of professional experience, but we will make exceptions for the right candidate 4. You want to work with the best. And you are excited to work in chips, solving the hardest problems at the frontier of AI WHAT WE OFFER
1. Competitive compensation and meaningful equity
2. A very cool office with London's best views
3. Private medical insurance and pension benefits If this sounds like you, ping carmen@fractile.ai

description: meetyogi.com | Senior Software Engineer, Backend / Product | $180-220k | Hybrid NYC | Series A | 35 headcount, ~10 in engineering Yogi aggregates and analyzes millions of customer feedback data points from online retailer reviews, social, cx ticketing systems, etc to help companies make better decisions about their products and markets. We operate mostly in CPG, where our customers are household brands you'd recognize, both enterprise and up-and-coming. -- Everyone is kind and engaged with work at Yogi. It's a nice vibe. Our stack is pretty standard SaaS - python (fastapi, prefect), postgres/clickhouse, react/typescript web app. The app experience is what you'd expect from a data analytics platform - charting and agentic workflows that generate insights from the data. In terms of the moment, we're reaching the bounds of some early domain assumptions, while also figuring out how to expand into new ones. On the code front, broadly speaking we're improving quality and process each quarter by an order of magnitude. AI has been a boon for us. (I've personally invested a lot in our dev tooling to make code output high quality and deterministic) There's a lot of greenfield opportunity and also scale challenges to be solved on existing tech. No shortage of things to do, ownership is as much as you want to take on. -- Interview process is a chit chat with our CTO, an onsite with a practical coding exercise (not crazy i promise), a system design conversation, and behavioral interview. Email me at jon.young(at)meetyogi.com or connect w me on linkedin /joncyoungii if you want to learn more. Happy to answer any questions you have honestly and refer you if it makes sense on both ends
